initialization: Use the same checked parent actor, admitted shared critic, fitted critic optimizer state, observation and physics configuration, reset seed, exploration stream and minibatch seed. Freeze the actor normalization and non-MLP tensors. Both arms use the same 1024 saved steady right-turn inputs for retention.
comparison: Only the native reward coefficient changes. The control uses 0 and the candidate uses 0.25 for the bounded startup deficit. Compare the same budget of native PPO samples. The first 24-control batch is retained and used for an actual forward/backward memory check before any optimizer step.
selection: 14 updates per arm is the fixed pilot budget, providing native samples past the 4-second shaping window. Verify the two exported ONNX models and their recoverable checkpoints. Then compare the unchanged routed parent, control and candidate on the original seven-command criteria on separate development seeds. Preserve the original non-right routes. No extension or heldout use until the functional result is reviewed.
stop: Stop before any optimizer step if the first-batch gradient, value target, memory cap, starting-state pairing, or observer prerequisite fails. Stop on subsequent numeric, contact, resource or KL bounds. Archive partial output without automated restart.
